plan.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison and dexterity scaling
plan.bossPrep: Build reliable poison and Weak, retain sufficient block, and use discard to clear Beckon. Enter near full health with defensive potions.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then poison and defensive scaling. Take elites only with adequate health and burst damage. Upgrade core cards when safe; preserve health for the boss.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity, efficient block, and draw
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Afterimage and poison amplification when safe. Establish Fumes and dexterity early; prepare Weak, multihit mitigation, defensive potions, and a healthy boss entry.
plan.summary: Use sustained energy to block while poison grows. Shops should prioritize dexterity, draw, and poison amplification over redundant attacks. Remove Strikes, avoid elites, and heal when needed.

plan.archetype: Poison and Rolling Boulder scaling behind dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with potions. Upgrade Footwork or Rolling Boulder when safe; establish scaling early and prepare Weak plus multihit mitigation.
plan.summary: Prioritize draw to find existing powers, then poison amplification and multihit mitigation. Remove weak attacks, avoid elites, and preserve gold for Golden Seal. Do not build around Finale without reliable draw control.

plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Footwork, Accelerant, and Boulder when safe. Establish scaling quickly; secure defensive potions and preserve HP for both consecutive bosses.
plan.summary: Use the early shop for draw, removals, and protective potions. Avoid elites and redundant attacks. Three campfires support healing and safe core upgrades; prioritize reliable scaling access over more deck growth.
